input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for velocity tools bean definition registry post processor. Secondary concerns include content management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with velocity layout functionality, so that I can accomplish my velocity layout-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use velocity tools bean definition registry post processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
